sourceText:
American Muffins
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, February 10, 2010 - 5:17pm

Ingredients




cup plain flour
cup sugar
teaspoon salt
2 teaspoons baking powder
1 egg
cup milk
cup vegetable oil
1 flavouring ingredient
cup chopped apple and 1/2 tsp cinnamon
25 grams chocolate chips
cup raisins
ctn blueberry yoghurt

Preparation

1 Sieve together the flour sugar salt and baking powder. 2 Stir in the flavouring of your choice. 3 Beat the egg add milk and oil. 4 Stir into dry ingredients until evenly moistened. 5 Fill muffin tins lined with cake cases. 6 Bake on second set of runners from top of the roasting oven. 7 Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until risen and browned. 8 Serve warm with butter. 9 This is a truly american recipe. Vary the flavourings according to what is in the store cupboard. They are good for breakfast made with wholemeal flour and served with butter and honey. Use traditional deep muffin tins or smaller english bun tins. I have used teacup measures accuracy is not important. 10 Makes about 6 muffins
